# TimePickerVariant

`Flare.Components.TimePickerVariant`

Visual style of the FlareTimePicker popup.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dial` | `0` | Analog clock dial, 12-hour with AM/PM or 24-hour with two rings: pick the hour, then the minute, by pointer or by typing digits. Unlike the Material 2/3 time picker dialog, the popup has no keyboard-entry mode of its own - typing goes into the field, which is always editable. |
| `Dropdown` | `1` | Scrollable hour, minute and (with seconds) second columns. Used by every theme, including Fluent UI 2, whose own time picker is a single combobox list of times; that list is not provided. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDateTimePicker`
- `FlareTimePicker`
